verdict.rationale: Docusaurus's built-in MDX support lets authors import components defined in other files into Markdown pages. Importing one shared file into many pages does keep repeated content in sync, but the evidence frames this as React component embedding, not a dedicated snippet or partials feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of Markdown partials or snippet includes, any variable or token substitution mechanism, and independent or hands-on corroboration of content reuse across pages.

support.subject: As a technical writer, reusable snippets and variables keep repeated content in sync across pages

citations.quote: You can also import your own components defined in other files or third-party components installed via npm.
Docusaurus has built-in support for MDX, which allows you to write JSX within your Markdown files and render them as React components.
